t: Michigan Toy Soldiers and Historical Miniatures - MPC Model Plastics Company
s: Model Products Corporation or the acronym MPC, was a plastic model company started in 1963. It produced highly accurate and detailed kits and pre-assembled promotional models, mainly of cars, but also aircraft. These were all normally molded in plastic at 1:25 scale, but sometimes large. Some classic kits are now being issued as this legendary model brand returns.
